texts: We are all on a pilgrimage. That is the human condition.
I paint so that viewers can see in a new way not only my journey but the monumental pathways of this beautiful world.
I see so many chapters written in oil on canvas—many of them telling of beauty, and thus the Spirit of life itself.
Every painting tells a story about a place or about people, and every painting teaches a lesson about faith and those who came before us.
